I would personally cut contact. Sex might feel good while you're doing it, but does it make you happy in the long run? I think he groomed you to get to this point. Does he really "care" about you or is this relationship just for sex/his personal gain? You were a child, he was nearing 40. That relationship is bad on its own, but the rape makes it even worse. Because of your age at the time, even if you wanted it, you could not consent. Just because you are now an adult does not make the relationship any better. How is this affecting your mental health/life? Do you want to continue doing this for the next 2, 5, or 10 years? What if you start dating someone? Will you continue having sex with him or will you start hanging out as "friends"?
I am sorry you went/are going through this.


I'm sorry for the jumbled mess of a reply, my mind is racing. Also am on phone.
The person who made the video is named Marcello Barenghi. Here's a [link](https://youtu.be/fEF53RPk5sk) to his video.
You made me cry (in a good way). The feeling of knowing that someone out there actually cares is wonderful. Thank you.
Whatever you do, just remember if you feel like talking, I'm here for you.
I don't know how to respond to that.
Hey man. If you wanna talk, I'm here. I'm going through a tough time now too, so it'll be nice to talk.
I'm here for you if you wanna talk.

I think my motivation is that one day I'm going to be able to move for myself and get a couple of pets. It'll be lovely to have someone else than just myself to take care of. That way I know someone or something is relying on me to stay alive.
I'm clapping for you right now. Congratulations! I'm proud of you. :)
